First Solar (FSLR) Holding Increased by Bradley Foster & Sargent Inc; Shareholder Olstein Capital Management LP Increased Discovery Communications New (DISCK) Stake
May 25, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Olstein Capital Management Lp increased its stake in Discovery Communications New (DISCK) by 53.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Olstein Capital Management Lp bought 276,250 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 795,250 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.84 million, up from 519,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Olstein Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Discovery Communications New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.02B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.94% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $21.04. About 942,232 shares traded. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ:DISCK) has declined 27.22% since May 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.77% the S&P500.
